name: Build
oneLiner: Write code only after the plan is accepted, and stay inside it.
goal: Turn the accepted plan into the change, and leave every new idea for later.

steps.title: Wait for acceptance
steps.text: Do not write application code while the plan is still open.

steps.title: Implement the plan
steps.text: Build what the accepted plan names, and nothing past it.

steps.title: Stay inside the plan
steps.text: When a new idea appears, stop. It goes back to Plan as a change request.

doneChecks.text: Application code waits until the plan is accepted.
The change stays inside the accepted plan.

pitfalls.text: Writing application code while the plan is still a draft.
Adding a new idea during the build instead of sending it back to Plan.

quotes.text: Build waits until the plan is accepted.

optionGroups.label: Plan first
optionGroups.help: Does the plan still need a yes before any code?

options.label: Accept the plan first
options.detail: Do not write code until the plan is accepted.
options.promptFragment: Do not write application code until the plan is accepted. If the plan is still open, stop after the plan.

options.label: Implement in this session
options.promptFragment: The plan is accepted. Implement it in this session. Keep the change inside the accepted plan.

optionGroups.label: Who runs the checks
optionGroups.help: Skip this when you have not decided who runs the checks.

options.label: The agent verifies
options.detail: Run the checks and report the result.
options.promptFragment: Run the checks for this change and report the command and the result. A green run shows the build matched the plan. It does not decide that the result is right.

options.label: The author verifies
options.detail: Leave the commands for the author.
options.promptFragment: Do not run the checks. Name the command the author should run, and leave the result for them.
